subject: Post-demo governance playbook and decision-owners recap
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novumhealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo governance playbook and decision-owners recap

Hi Emily & Carlos,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciate the candor from the security and procurement teams. Per our run-through, I wanted to consolidate the decisions we discussed, confirm owners, and outline the immediate next steps so we keep momentum. I’ve attached a short governance playbook and a draft mutual-action-plan (MAP) for your review.

Quick recap:
- Economic buyer: Emily Zhao (you confirmed budget conversation next week)
- Security review: Priya Malhotra (security lead) will own questionnaire & evidence collection
- Procurement: Carlos Mendes will lead contract intake and procurement timeline
- Decision criteria: latency SLA (95th pct), encryption at-rest & in-transit, SOC2 evidence, and data residency / logging controls

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Priya: I attached our security Q&A and a short checklist — can you confirm if any additional controls are required by Fri, May 3? (attachment: novum_security_qs_answers.xlsx)
2) Carlos: Can you share your preferred procurement template and estimated review window? We can prepare redlines and a focused SOW in parallel.
3) Emily: Confirm whether you want a short POC (2–3 week pilot) or go straight to a reserved capacity purchase. If POC, we'll scope success metrics and a sample prompt-set.

Attachments: redwood-governance-playbook-v1.pdf, novum_security_qs_answers.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-novum.xlsx

I'll follow up with a proposed MAP calendar and a link to a short shared Drive in a follow-up. Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0176

--
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novumhealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@healthgrid.io>
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo governance playbook and decision-owners recap

Thanks Evelyn — added a few notes to the playbook and MAP (see attached v1 comments). A couple internal clarifications for our routing:
- If Novum requests SOC2 Type II evidence, we can surface our SOC2 report + scoped controls doc within 3 business days.
- For a POC, recommend we propose a 2-week pilot scoped to a single use-case (document ingestion + redaction) with a simple SLA: 200ms median gen latency for documents <512 tokens.

Internal ask: Aditya, can you confirm GPU/instance profile for a 2-week pilot and any constraints on logging retention for Novum? I want to ensure we can present an accurate cost estimate when Carlos asks.

Cheers,
Rachel
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 28 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo governance playbook and decision-owners recap

Evelyn / team — thanks for the recap. A few quick items from procurement side:
- Procurement template: attaching our standard MSA template (we use a redline-first approach). Target legal review window: 10 business days once we have a proposed SOW + redlines.
- Budget cadence: Emily will confirm the budget hold next Tue (May 2). If approved, we prefer a POC converted to a term with a short carve-out for data residency in the SOW.
- Evidence: Priya, please confirm if the novum_security_qs_answers.xlsx covers everything; if not, list missing artifacts and we’ll route requests internally.

Action items I’ll own:
1) Upload procurement template to your Drive by Mon, Apr 30 (will post link).
2) Share internal stakeholder list for legal review (names + emails) by Tue, May 3.

Attachments referenced: procurement_msa_template.docx (not attached here — will upload to Drive)

—Carlos
Head of Procurement | HealthGrid (procurement partner supporting Novum)

Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo governance playbook and decision-owners recap

Hi all — quick sync now that I have a couple confirmations:
- Emily confirmed budget hold for pilot (thanks!) — Emily: appreciate if you can send calendar invite when you’ve got availability for a short kickoff next week.
- Carlos: noted the 10 business day legal review window; appreciate upload of MSA when ready.
- Priya: flagged two items from your team in the security doc — we’ll provision a scoped log-retention opt-in and a dedicated evidence bundle for SOC2 artifacts.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Evelyn: finalize MAP + calendar and send by Thu, May 3 (ACTION: I will post Drive link + MAP).
- Rachel: prepare pilot SOW draft (2-week POC) with suggested success criteria by Fri, May 4.
- Aditya: estimate infra profile & cost for pilot and confirm logging retention options by Fri, May 4.
- Carlos: upload MSA and legal stakeholder list by Tue, May 9.
- Priya: confirm any additional security artifacts required by Mon, May 7.

I’ve uploaded the playbook with Rachel’s notes to the shared Drive and included the MAP spreadsheet — link below in case anyone needs it.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NOVUM-REDWOOD-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2028-1198

If there are objections to the timeline, flag them here and we’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll send the MAP + calendar invite this afternoon.

Thanks all,
Evelyn
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0176
